purpose: Machine-readable Orion application feature catalog for retrieval-augmented assistants. Use this file to answer where-to-go and how-to-use questions with routes, prerequisites, and step-by-step workflows.

default_rules.visibility: Features can be hidden by role, account status, tenant license, subscription access, module license, onboarding state, system setting, or mobile layout.
search_workflow: Enter the query or target value.
Choose a category or tab if needed.
Review metadata, pivots, exported data, or AI actions if available.

features.title: Login
troubleshooting: Confirm the account is active.
Use password reset if credentials are unknown.
Ask an administrator to verify account status.

features.title: Signup
steps: Enter required user and company information.
Wait for tenant or administrator approval when configured.
troubleshooting: Some deployments disable public signup.
Ask an administrator to create the account if signup is unavailable.

features.title: Password Reset
steps: Open the reset link from email.
Enter and confirm the new password.
troubleshooting: Check email delivery.
Request a new reset link if the token expired.

features.title: Tenant Onboarding
steps: Add initial IOC values when requested.
troubleshooting: Confirm tenant assignment.
Confirm the tenant has an active license.
Ask an administrator to verify onboarding state.

features.title: Homepage
steps: Use the global search input for broad investigation.
Select IOCs, Deep Search, or Network Intelligence if shown.
Open a card, alert, or result for details.
troubleshooting: Homepage content varies by role, tenant, license, and onboarding state.

features.title: Global Search
troubleshooting: Remove filters if no results appear.
Use Match any term for broader matching.
Try Consolidated for cross-module discovery.

features.title: Consolidated Investigation
steps: Enter an IOC, domain, email, username, hash, organization, or keyword.
Review IOCs, Deep Search, and Network Intel tabs.
troubleshooting: If hidden, confirm subscription access.
Try General Intelligence if Consolidated is not available.

features.title: General Intelligence
steps: Start with All unless a category is known.
Search a keyword, actor, organization, domain, product, event, or phrase.
troubleshooting: Use Consolidated for broader cross-module search.
Use Feed for stream-style news reading.

features.title: Data Breach
steps: Search an email, username, organization, domain, credential marker, or keyword.
troubleshooting: Use Email Breach for a direct email lookup.
Use Stealer Logs for credential artifact pivots.

features.title: Discussion And Social Search
steps: Choose a platform category if known.
Search a username, channel, topic, keyword, domain, or IOC.
Open a chat or social report.
troubleshooting: Use Social Intel for relationship mapping instead of indexed content search.

features.title: Feed
troubleshooting: Use General Intelligence for more precise filtered search.

features.title: Exploit Intelligence
steps: Choose All, CVE, Tools, or ZeroDay.
Search a CVE, product, exploit name, actor, or keyword.
troubleshooting: Use General Intelligence if the vulnerability context is broader than exploit records.

features.title: Defacement
steps: Choose Hacked, Phishing, Databases, or All.
Search by domain, URL, organization, attacker handle, or keyword.
Review screenshot, metadata, and extracted indicators.
troubleshooting: Use Basic Web Scan for live inspection of a current website.

features.title: Dump Listings
steps: Search the leak URL, domain, keyword, or identifier.
troubleshooting: If hidden, confirm subscription access.
Use Stealer Logs for stealer-specific credential artifacts.

features.title: Stealer Logs
steps: Search a domain, IP, email, username, URL, or indicator.
Review returned credential or IOC records.
Pivot to reports or alerts when relevant.
troubleshooting: If hidden, confirm subscription access.

features.title: Entity API Overview
steps: Choose the scanner matching the target.
troubleshooting: If hidden, confirm subscription access.

features.title: Email Breach
troubleshooting: Use Data Breach for broader indexed breach searches.

features.title: Social Scanner
steps: Enter the username, handle, or profile value.
troubleshooting: Use Social Intel for graph-style profile mapping.

features.title: Wanted List
troubleshooting: Try alternate name formats if no match appears.

features.title: National Identity
troubleshooting: Confirm the identity value format is supported.

features.title: Playstore Scanner
steps: Enter the application reference or package.
Review app metadata and risk indicators.
troubleshooting: Use APK Scan if you have the APK file rather than a store reference.

features.title: Software Scanner
steps: Enter the software name, package, URL, or supported value.
troubleshooting: Try exact package names or URLs if broad names return too many results.

features.title: File Scanner
steps: Review extracted IOCs and analysis output.
troubleshooting: Confirm the file type and size are supported.
Use returned IOCs in Consolidated or IOC alerts.

features.title: Text Analysis
steps: Review classification, extracted values, and risk indicators.
troubleshooting: If API returns 403, enable AI Endpoint Enabled in System Settings.
Confirm AI module license.

features.title: Crypto Scanner
steps: Enter the cryptocurrency address or supported value.
Review metadata, risk, and linked activity.
troubleshooting: Confirm the address format and chain are supported.

features.title: Basic Web Scan
steps: Enter the target domain or URL.
Review the report and extracted indicators.
troubleshooting: Confirm the target is a valid domain or URL.
Check scanner service availability if the scan does not complete.

features.title: Network Intel
steps: Choose Host Recon, IP Scan, or Vulnerability Scan.
Enter the domain, host, or IP.
Review DNS, IP, port, vulnerability, location, or host details.
troubleshooting: If hidden, confirm subscription access.
Network Intel may be disabled in mobile mode.

features.title: Repository Scan
steps: Enter the repository URL or reference.
Review exposure, metadata, or risk findings.
troubleshooting: Confirm repository URL format and accessibility.

features.title: SEO Scan
steps: Enter the target domain or URL.
troubleshooting: Confirm the target URL starts with http or https if required.

features.title: APK Scan
steps: Review permissions, behaviors, static indicators, and extracted IOCs.
troubleshooting: Confirm the uploaded file is an APK.
Use Playstore Scanner if you only have a store reference.

features.title: AI Workspace
steps: Open Profile -> AI or click the homepage AI button.
Enter the prompt, question, or content.
Continue the conversation or pivot to a report.
troubleshooting: If the button is missing, enable AI Endpoint Enabled in System Settings.
If API returns 403, AI Endpoint Enabled is off.
Confirm AI module license.

features.title: AI Report Summary
troubleshooting: If hidden or blocked, check AI Endpoint Enabled and AI license.

features.title: Report Chat
troubleshooting: If API returns 403, enable AI Endpoint Enabled.
Confirm the user can access the report.

features.title: CTI Graph
steps: Search or load a graph context.
Use context menus to expand or pivot.
Switch to list view if needed.
troubleshooting: Use a result report first if you need a concrete graph starting point.

features.title: Social Intel
steps: Search for a username, handle, profile, or platform identity.
Review metadata, profiles, followers, following, posts, images, and relationships.
Switch between graph and list views.
troubleshooting: Use Social Search for indexed content rather than profile relationship mapping.

features.title: Tenant Homepage And Alert Summary
steps: Review monitored IOC and alert cards.
Start or cancel scans if available.
Add or manage custom alert values.
troubleshooting: Content varies by role, license, and tenant state.

features.title: Alerts
steps: Mark seen, update, delete, export, or pivot where available.
troubleshooting: Confirm the tenant has monitored IOCs.
Run alert scan if available.

features.title: Add Custom Alert
steps: Choose the alert type or category.
troubleshooting: Confirm the user has member access and active account status.

features.title: Manage IOCs
steps: Run or wait for alert scanning as configured.
troubleshooting: Confirm the value format is valid for the selected IOC type.

features.title: Account Settings
steps: Toggle preferences such as theme, two-factor, or profile visibility.
troubleshooting: Some fields may be read-only depending on role.

features.title: Tenant Settings
troubleshooting: Confirm role and license if edit controls are missing.

features.title: System Settings
steps: Update app name, language, onion address, homepage links, branding assets, or feature toggles.
Toggle AI Endpoint Enabled to allow or block AI UI and AI backend endpoints.
troubleshooting: Admin role is required to save settings.
URLs must start with http:// or https://.
AI Endpoint Enabled is stored as ai_endpoint_enabled.

features.title: Users
licenses: subscription or maintainer depending on workflow
steps: Search or review the user list.
Update allowed fields, role, status, or tenant assignment.
troubleshooting: Confirm maintainer/admin access if user management controls are missing.

features.title: User Activity
steps: Open a user profile from Users or a profile link.
Return to the previous administration page.
troubleshooting: Confirm the user ID exists and current user can view it.

features.title: Tenant Administration
steps: Update tenant state where controls are available.
troubleshooting: Admin role is required for all-tenant view.

features.title: Audit Logs
steps: Filter by user, event, date, tenant, or available fields.
Delete audit entries only if allowed.
troubleshooting: Confirm role and maintainer license if audit logs are hidden.

features.title: Event Management
steps: Review available event rows or controls.
Add, update, or inspect events where controls are available.
troubleshooting: Confirm the module is enabled for the current role.

features.title: Feeder Management
steps: Review the catalog and existing scripts.
Upload a script or values where allowed.
Enable, disable, clear, delete, or transfer ownership as needed.
troubleshooting: If hidden, confirm module:feeder license.
Owner transfer requires admin.

features.title: Directory And Links
steps: Search or filter if controls are available.
troubleshooting: Some links are deployment-specific.

features.title: Support
troubleshooting: Enter a valid email address and non-empty message.

features.title: Documentation
steps: Open Documentation from the sidebar or header.
Browse the platform introduction, module introduction, user manual, feature guide, or API docs.
troubleshooting: Visibility can depend on system metadata settings.

features.title: Onion Link
steps: Open the Onion Link from the sidebar.
Use the configured onion address in a supported browser.
troubleshooting: The link only appears when s_onion is configured in System Settings.

features.title: Whistle Blowing
steps: Open Whistle Blowing from the sidebar when visible.
troubleshooting: Visibility depends on system metadata settings.
